text:
Aisha: Quick handoff for AtlasSync (contract signed today). Context: mid-market SaaS, plan to start on hosted API; customer requested EU private eval for data residency. They'll use embeddings heavily. Sales noted EU latency blips in perf run and procurement asked about 12mo terms (timeline ~6 weeks). Renewal/watch risk if onboarding stalls.

Tom: I'll own CS. Aisha, can you attach final contract + perf log snippet and SSO contact?

Aisha: Links: https://drive.redwood/AtlasSync/AtlasSync_Final.pdf and https://perf.redwood/atlasync/eu-spikes-2026.log. SSO contact: nina@atlasync.com. Procurement/PO: marc@atlasync.com.

Tom: Draft kickoff plan: 1) Confirm owners, 2) EU smoke perf test, 3) SAML handshake window + config, 4) embedding volume forecast + cost mitigations, 5) Private eval if perf/SSO blocks. Tentative owners: Tom (CS lead), Ravi (support/runbook), Zoe (eng/private perf sizing).

Ravi: I'll open a support ticket and start the runbook. Need steps to reproduce the spike, sample payloads, and whether they can whitelist test IPs.

Zoe: For perf sizing I need model name/quant, max seq length, expected concurrency/tokens/sec, and a representative corpus. Sample load command I'll run: 

```bash
# vegeta throughput profile example
echo '{"method":"POST","url":"https://api.redwood/v1/generate","body":"{\"model\":\"open-emb-001\",\"input\":\"test prompt\"}","header":{"Authorization":"Bearer $TOKEN","Content-Type":"application/json"}}' > targets.json
vegeta attack -targets=targets.json -rate=50 -duration=30s | vegeta report
```

Zoe: If we hit host limits we can request a temporary dedicated test pool from eng-infra.

Tom: I'll upload the customer's prompt set and embed workload CSV to the shared folder and ask AtlasSync for three success metrics: P50/P95 latency, embed cost per 10k, and SAML pass rate.

Aisha: I'll get Nina to approve a SAML test window for Tue/Wed morning UTC. Also notified SalesOps about procurement timeline.

Ravi: Ticket SUP-10221 created and linked to folder. Checklist: reproduce spike, collect request IDs, confirm regional routing, gather traces. Added 'workaround/status' field for quick mitigations.

onboard-bot: Enterprise onboarding template attached: https://wiki.redwood/onboarding/enterprise-template. Added "EU smoke" test step.

Tom: Owners & next steps summary: - CS: Tom (kickoff & weekly updates) - Support: Ravi (SUP-10221 + runbook) - Eng: Zoe (perf tests + private sizing) - Sales: Aisha (SSO approval + procurement)

Tom: Immediate commitments: 1) Aisha get SAML approval from Nina by EOD Fri. 2) Ravi populate SUP-10221 with logs/reproducer within 24h. 3) Zoe review perf logs and confirm data needs within 48h. 4) Tom run cost forecast and propose mitigations in 72h.

Zoe: I'll start with the log extract and post questions in ~36h.

Aisha: Pushed procurement update to AE and looped Marc.

Tom: Weekly sync cadence: Wednesdays 14:00 UTC. Marking account as "onboarding-watch" until SSO validated + first smoke pass. Ping here for blockers and tag @Ravi or @Zoe for urgent issues. :thumbsup:
